CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mip_private.arc_has_approved_membership(p_arc_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select exists (select 1 from public.arc_membership_candidates c where c.arc_id = p_arc_id and c.state = 'approved'); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mip_private.arc_event_candidate_is_approved(p_candidate_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select p_candidate_id is not null and exists (select 1 from public.arc_membership_candidates c where c.id = p_candidate_id and c.state = 'approved'); $function$
